title: Best Conductor Alternatives 2026: Pricing Compared
summary: The best Conductor alternatives for 2026: BrightEdge, seoClarity, Profound and Sprites, with buyer-reported pricing for the platforms that publish none.
body_markdown:
**The best Conductor alternatives in 2026 are BrightEdge and seoClarity if you want another enterprise platform, and Sprites if you want the work done instead of reported.** Conductor, BrightEdge and seoClarity all sell dashboards and a customer success manager on annual contracts around $34,000 to $50,000 a year. Sprites is an AI agent that tracks, writes and publishes the fixes, and it is free to start.


## The short answer


- **Want the work done:**[Sprites](https://www.sprites.ai/ai-seo) , free to start, no contract, publishes the fixes to your CMS.
- **Want a like-for-like platform:** BrightEdge for data depth, seoClarity for published prices.
- **Leaving for AI search:** Profound for enterprise,[Peec AI](https://www.sprites.ai/blog/peec-ai-review) for affordable tracking.
- **Want a suite you can buy today:** Semrush or Ahrefs.


One year, one scale. The enterprise bars are buyer-reported medians because none of the three puts that number on its site.


## Conductor pricing in 2026


Conductor’s pricing page shows three plans, Essentials, Growth and Enterprise, on a “usage-based model”, and no prices. What the plans are sized on is published: Writing Assistant drafts (60, 180 and 600 a year) and websites monitored (up to 3, 5 and 10 or more). Everything else is quoted after a demo, though a three-week free trial is available.


Conductor’s pricing page, September 21, 2026: plans, a trial and a demo request, but no prices.


Buyers report a median of about $49,000 a year, with typical deals from $30,000 to more than $150,000. Contracts are annual or multi-year, and the common extras are onboarding fees, keyword-tracking overages, seats added mid-contract and professional services. Conductor’s 2026 product line is Conductor Intelligence for SEO and AEO reporting, Creator for content drafts, Monitoring (formerly ContentKing) for technical site health, an MCP server, and AgentStack, a suite of AI agents launched on April 20, 2026.


Conductor’s launch of AgentStack, its enterprise agent suite for AEO.


## Why teams look for a Conductor alternative


- **Price opacity.** A five-figure contract before anyone can see a number, and extras that arrive after signing.
- **Seats, not output.** The platform reports; someone still has to research, write, publish and re-check. Without an in-house SEO lead, modules go unused.
- **Implementation time.** Weeks of onboarding and training before the first result.
- **AI search is changing the job.** Rankings still matter, but the question buyers ask now is whether ChatGPT and Google’s AI Overviews recommend you. That needs pages written for the prompt, not another report.


[See how AI search grades you today, free →](https://www.sprites.ai/tools/aeo-grader) Free. A live A–F grade across ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, with the three fixes that move it most.


## The best Conductor alternatives in 2026


### 1. Sprites: Best Conductor alternative that does the work


Sprites: Free to start.


Enterprise SEO platforms sell you a dashboard and a customer success manager. Sprites sells you an agent that does the work. It researches keywords and buyer prompts, tracks your rankings and your visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google’s AI answers, writes the pages and fixes, and publishes them to WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, Framer or Wix once you approve. The same agent runs your Google, Meta and LinkedIn ads.


No annual contract, no implementation project, no onboarding fee: sign up, connect the site, approve the first fix the same day. **Best for:** mid-market teams and lean enterprise teams that want output, not seats. **Limits:** not a 50,000-keyword rank-tracking warehouse; SSO is on the Scale plan.


### 2. BrightEdge: Best for data-heavy enterprise SEO


BrightEdge: Not published; buyer-reported median about $50,000/yr.


BrightEdge is the data-depth choice: Data Cube for keyword and competitive research, Instant for real-time SERP data, Autopilot for automated on-page fixes, and AI Catalyst with its Generative Parser for AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity. It launched AI Hyper Cube in March 2026 and Agent Edge, for AI agents visiting your site, in August.


Buyers report a median of about $50,000 a year, on 12 to 36-month terms with 3–7% renewal escalators and add-on modules on top. **Best for:** large SEO teams running share-of-voice programmes. **Limits:** a steep learning curve, and a two-to-three-month adoption period before most teams self-serve.


### 3. seoClarity: The enterprise platform that publishes its prices


seoClarity: From $2,500/mo; buyer-reported median about $34,000/yr.


seoClarity is the only one of the big three with prices on its site: Research & Content from $2,500 a month, Technical SEO from $3,200 and Enterprise from $4,500, with rank tracking quoted from a 2,000-keyword minimum. Clarity ArcAI tracks AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity; ClarityAutomate pushes changes at the edge; Sia is its AI assistant.


**Best for:** technical SEO teams that want unlimited crawling and log-file analysis. **Limits:** add-ons for the AI features, and a UI with a learning curve.


### 4. Profound: Best enterprise AEO specialist


Profound: Free 7-day trial; Enterprise custom.


If the reason you are leaving Conductor is AI search, Profound is the specialist: up to nine answer engines, real-conversation prompt demand data, AI crawler analytics and Agents that publish to WordPress, Sanity and Contentful. It is sold the same way as Conductor, through a demo and a custom contract. See[Profound pricing](https://www.sprites.ai/blog/profound-pricing) .


**Best for:** enterprise brands whose priority is AI answers over classic rankings. **Limits:** no classic SEO suite, no published price.


### 5. Semrush: Best suite for mixed SEO and content teams


Semrush: Plans from $139/mo; AI Visibility Toolkit $99/mo.


Semrush covers most of what mid-market teams use Conductor for, keyword research, rank tracking, site audits and content tools, at a published price, and adds AI visibility tracking for $99 a month per domain. See[Sprites vs Semrush](https://www.sprites.ai/compare/semrush) .


**Best for:** teams that want a self-serve suite. **Limits:** nothing is written or published for you.


### 6. Ahrefs: Best for backlink-led research


Ahrefs: $129 / $249 / $449 per month; Enterprise $1,499.


Ahrefs is the research workhorse, with the strongest backlink index, keyword data and site audits, plus Brand Radar for AI visibility from $199 a month on top. Usage limits and credits on the lower plans are its most common complaint. See[Sprites vs Ahrefs](https://www.sprites.ai/compare/ahrefs) .


**Best for:** SEO specialists who live in the data. **Limits:** research only; the output is yours to produce.


### 7. Peec AI: Best affordable AI visibility tracker


Peec AI: $95 / $245 / $495 per month.


For teams that already have an SEO suite and only need AI search tracking, Peec is the clean, affordable option: 50 to 350 prompts on three models, unlimited seats, daily runs. It does not write content. See the[Peec AI review](https://www.sprites.ai/blog/peec-ai-review) .


**Best for:** SEO teams adding AI visibility to an existing stack. **Limits:** tracking only.

## BrightEdge pricing


BrightEdge publishes no prices. Buyers report a median of about $50,000 a year, with most contracts between roughly $42,000 and $69,000, and entry deployments for a single user closer to $12,000. Terms run 12 to 36 months with annual prepay common, longer terms cut the yearly rate by 15–30%, and renewals carry 3–7% escalators. Modules such as DataMind, ContentIQ, Instant and Data Cube are priced separately.

## Conductor alternatives: frequently asked questions


### How much does Conductor cost?


Conductor does not publish prices. Its pricing page lists Essentials, Growth and Enterprise plans on a usage-based model and asks you to request a demo. Buyers report a median of about $49,000 a year, with typical contracts from $30,000 to more than $150,000, plus onboarding, overages and extra seats.


### What is the best alternative to Conductor?


For teams that want the work done, Sprites: it tracks rankings and AI visibility, then writes and publishes the fixes to your CMS, with no annual contract, and it is free to start. For a like-for-like enterprise platform, BrightEdge for data depth or seoClarity for published prices. For AI search specifically, Profound.


### Is BrightEdge better than Conductor?


Neither is better across the board. BrightEdge is stronger on data depth, rank and share-of-voice reporting and automated on-page fixes; Conductor is stronger on usability, content workflow and support. Reviewers describe a switch between them as a lateral move, and both cost roughly $50,000 a year at the median.


### How much does BrightEdge cost?


BrightEdge does not publish prices. Buyers report a median of about $50,000 a year, with most contracts between roughly $42,000 and $69,000, on 12 to 36-month terms. Add-on modules, onboarding, professional services and 3–7% renewal escalators are charged on top.


### How much does seoClarity cost?


seoClarity publishes starting prices: Research & Content from $2,500 a month, Technical SEO from $3,200 and Enterprise from $4,500, with rank tracking quoted on a 2,000-keyword minimum. Buyers report a median of about $34,000 a year.


### Does Conductor have a free trial?


Yes. Conductor offers a three-week free trial from its website. Its paid plans still require a demo and a quote.


### Which Conductor alternatives track AI search?


All of the enterprise platforms now track AI answers: BrightEdge with AI Catalyst, seoClarity with ArcAI and Conductor itself. Profound and Peec AI specialise in it. Sprites tracks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google’s AI surfaces and is the one that also writes and publishes the pages that win the prompts.
